text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Reading a saintess novel under the sun and letting my thoughts drift to an otherworldly realm... Ah, how wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That bench over there looks especially sunny. Fufufu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*squish!*)

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sorry, young lady!
Looks like the wet paint warning sign
on that bench peeled off!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh... no.
I am simply glad to have spared someone else the misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Phew. That being said,
I really need to get this paint off my bottom—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Kitty over there, being up in that tree is dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, come jump right in.
Into the saint's embrace——oof!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
T-To think it hit your face...
No, the most important thing is that you're unhurt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I wonder when it was that I started having thoughts like that whenever I saw her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was plagued by minor injuries and misfortune
to such an extent. I could keep an eye on her during
training, but—
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's doing alright with academy life?)
(I wonder if she's doing alright with academy life?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It weighed on my mind, and after that, I unconsciously found my eyes following her.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hafu, hafu...
Ugh... Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(I ordered mild carrot curry, but got
extra spicy chili pepper curry instead...
This was another grueling trial...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, doesn't she look super intense?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no problem...
I managed to... overcome the ordeal...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
By the way... do you want something sweet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, how do I put it? It just so happens...
Like, totally by chance, I ended up with extra.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right?
Then I would gladly...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, little bird...!
...Ah, it flew away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why'd you come all the way out to the Miho Dorms?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "The pressed violet I was using as a bookmark for my Saint novel was taken by a little bird... It was such a lovely violet, perfectly matching the novel's motif, too..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ha. Well, that's rough.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
……Hey, turn around.
You've got a flower stuck in your hair.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I hadn't noticed—
Wait, my! What lovely violets...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I could probably make a new bookmark out of this.
...Though, I wonder when it hitched a ride on me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that—whenever misfortune befell her,
the two would subtly step in to help.
No doubt it was their own way of looking out for her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And? What about Desire-chan's Trainer?
choice_data_list: As her trainer, I just wanted to say thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I expressed my gratitude for how often
she has been looking out for Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...It was merely a whim.
Nothing so grand as watching your back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Exactly. If someone's just moping around looking all sad, it only makes me wanna mess with 'em!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: No, listen—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are...!
Nakayama-san, Jordan-san!
Good day to you as well, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Hello, were you looking for those two?
Hello, were you looking for those two?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to tell the truth...
I made baked sweets in the blessed kiln. As a token of my daily gratitude, I wanted you two to have some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? As thanks?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel it day in and day out: the divine protection
of you both, illuminating my path as I take on these trials."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...A divine blessing? Don't recall anything like that."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Which means, there ain't no reason
to worry about thanks or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No. Even if it is subconscious... the fact remains
that I am helped by it day in and day out.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I find what you two did truly noble,
and I am deeply grateful. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I decorated one for Jordan-san, and made a spicy one for Nakayama-san.
Please, accept them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... if you're offering, I'll take it.
Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...!
No, the pleasure is mine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will continue to press forward as a saint,
and do my best to be a savior to you both!"
choice_data_list: Try not to push yourself too hard.
I should take a page from your book!
I should take a page from your book!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will continue to press forward as a saint,
and do my best to be a savior to you both!"
choice_data_list: Try not to push yourself too hard.
I should take a page from your book!
I should take a page from your book!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing too hard might backfire.
Especially in her case.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, what you do is your own business.
Struggle as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪
I will definitely live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I hope to always remain a saint worthy of hearing such kind words from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Man... that's seriously insane.
